provisions.title: Where to send a written notice

versions.summary: The landlord must give tenants, in writing, the name and address of the owner or manager. Send your written notices to that person.
details: Keep a copy of every notice.
Write down the date you sent it.

versions.summary: The landlord must give tenants an address for notices. Send your written notices to that address.
details: If the landlord did not give an address, use the way you usually contact the landlord: by hand, email, text, or mail.
Keep a copy of every notice.
Write down the date you sent it.
versions.app_impact: Update the first next-step detail and the 311 guidance to mention email and text as allowed delivery when no notice address was given.

versions.summary: For repairs, the RLTO counts 14 days from your written request to the landlord. Some tenant options start only after these 14 days.
details: Before you hold back rent or pay for a repair yourself, talk to legal aid. These options have steps you must follow.
Keep a copy of your request. Write down the date the landlord got it.

versions.summary: For repairs, the RLTO counts 14 days from your written request to the landlord. Some tenant options start only after these 14 days.
details: Before you hold back rent or pay for a repair yourself, talk to legal aid. These options have steps you must follow.
Keep a copy of your request. Write down the date the landlord got it.
versions.app_impact: No change to the 14-day period. Update the section label. The introduced text raises the repair-and-deduct limit and requires a licensed professional; the app does not show dollar limits.

provisions.title: No heat, water, gas, or power: 24 hours

versions.summary: For no heat, no running water, no hot water, no electricity, no gas, or no plumbing, the RLTO uses shorter times. Some options start 24 hours after your written notice.
details: Other options start 72 hours after your written notice.
These rules do not apply when the utility company caused the problem.
Talk to legal aid before you hold back rent or move out.

versions.summary: For no heat, no running water, no hot water, no electricity, no gas, or no plumbing, the RLTO uses shorter times. Some options start 24 hours after your written notice.
details: This also covers internet service when the lease says the landlord provides it.
Other options start 72 hours after your written notice.
These rules do not apply when the utility company caused the problem.
Talk to legal aid before you hold back rent or move out.
versions.app_impact: Consider an 'internet' quick fact for building-wide messages. Update the section label.

versions.summary: The landlord must give at least two days' notice before entering your unit, except in an emergency.
details: The law treats entry between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM as reasonable.
After an emergency entry, the landlord must tell you within two days.

versions.summary: The landlord must give at least 48 hours' notice before entering your unit, except in an emergency.
details: The law treats entry between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM as reasonable.
After an emergency entry, the landlord must tell you within 48 hours.
The landlord must keep a way to enter for repairs. Not being able to enter does not excuse missing basic repairs.
versions.app_impact: Entry notices already say 48 hours. No template change needed.

versions.summary: A landlord may not end your lease, raise rent, cut services, refuse to renew, or start an eviction because you asked for repairs in good faith.
details: This also covers good-faith complaints to the City, like 311, and to community groups or tenant unions.
Illinois law has similar protections.

versions.summary: A landlord may not end your lease, raise rent, cut services, refuse to renew, or start an eviction because you asked for repairs in good faith.
details: This also covers good-faith complaints to the City, like 311, and to community groups or tenant unions.
It also covers organizing with neighbors and complaints on social media.
Illinois law has similar protections.
versions.app_impact: Building-wide messages are protected organizing. Consider a short note on the building-wide message step.

versions.summary: The landlord must return the deposit, minus allowed deductions, within 45 days after you move out.
details: To deduct for damage, the landlord must send an itemized list within 30 days after you move out, with costs and receipts.
The landlord must pay interest each year if it holds the deposit more than six months.

versions.summary: The landlord must return the deposit, minus allowed deductions, within 45 days after you move out.
details: A deposit may not be more than one month's rent.
If you ask in writing for missing deposit information, the landlord has two business days to send it.
To deduct for damage, the landlord must send an itemized list within 30 days after you move out, with costs and receipts.
versions.app_impact: The introduced text removes the interest-bearing account rule after the start date. Review the deposit interest card when the final text is known.

versions.summary: A landlord may not change locks, remove doors, remove your things, or shut off heat, water, or power to make you leave.
details: The Chicago Police Department enforces this rule.

versions.summary: A landlord may not change locks, remove doors, remove your things, or shut off heat, water, power, or internet to make you leave.
details: The Chicago Police Department enforces this rule.
versions.app_impact: Add 'internet shut off' to lockout quick facts.

versions.summary: Owners must register each rental unit with the City every year. The City keeps a public, searchable list. It includes the contact for repair requests.
details: The landlord must give you a copy of the registration at the start of the lease.
versions.app_impact: Add a link to the registry search so residents can find where to send repair requests. Do not store owner names in Building Ledger.

versions.summary: A new City bureau would receive 311 complaints about the RLTO and investigate them.
versions.app_impact: 311 stays the next normal step. Update 311 guidance once the City publishes the 311 category name for RLTO complaints.

versions.summary: Tenants may form or join a tenant union, hand out flyers, and use common spaces to organize, as the law allows.
versions.app_impact: Supports the building-wide message flow. No feature change needed.
